title: Turned my dog into a pixel art game character
author: Chologism
selftext:
I'd seen some people mention that they have done this, so I thought let's try it out for myself. I had no idea it would turn out to be so good! (in my opinion)

This took me only 3 minutes to do:

\> Grab a photo of your pet, that show their defining characteristics (more photos is better)  
\> Generate a pixel art character based on the photos  
\> Iterate if needed (for me this was the first result and I loved it)  
\> Run the character image through the character animator  
\> Try it out directly in the browser, and export the animations to whatever game engine

comments.author: Chologism
comments.body:
You can try this out for free (1 character), I explain more about how here:

[https://www.spritecook.ai/blog/animate-your-pet](https://www.spritecook.ai/blog/animate-your-pet)
